import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Feature engineering for f_27 (long string column)
def extract_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Extract character-level features
    for i, char in enumerate("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"):
        df[f"char_{char}_count"] = df["f_27"].str.count(char)

    # String length
    df["f_27_len"] = df["f_27"].str.len()

    # Unique characters count
    df["f_27_unique"] = df["f_27"].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))

    # First and last character
    df["f_27_first"] = df["f_27"].str[0]
    df["f_27_last"] = df["f_27"].str[-1]

    return df


train = extract_features(train)
test = extract_features(test)

# Target encode categorical columns
cat_cols = ["f_29", "f_30", "f_27_first", "f_27_last"]
for col in cat_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    combined = pd.concat([train[col], test[col]], axis=0).astype(str)
    le.fit(combined)
    train[col] = le.transform(train[col].astype(str))
    test[col] = le.transform(test[col].astype(str))

# Select feature columns (exclude id, target, and original f_27)
feature_cols = [col for col in train.columns if col not in ["id", "target", "f_27"]]

# Prepare data
X = train[feature_cols]
y = train["target"]
X_test = test[feature_cols]

# Split for validation (90/10)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Train Random Forest
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=0,
)

rf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Validate
val_pred = rf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Train final model on full training data
rf_full = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_split=10,
    min_samples_leaf=5,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=0,
)
rf_full.fit(X, y)

# Make predictions on test set
test_pred = rf_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
